title: Why SC after Riemann mapping
summary: Riemann mapping guarantees a disk↔region map but rarely writes a formula. Schwarz–Christoffel gives explicit integral maps from half-plane/disk to polygons by prescribing turning angles at prevertices.
math: SC form (schematic): f'(z) ∝ ∏ (z−x_k)^{α_k−1} for exterior/interior angles α_k.

title: Straight sides + corners as branch factors
summary: Walk straight edges until a vertex, turn by prescribed angle—encoded by power factors in f'. Applications: conformal maps in engineering (airfoils, electrostatics) at slogan level.
